segments.name: Biotechnology
segments.description: A biotechnology company focused on T cell immune profiling and in vitro diagnostics for viral and immune-mediated diseases, serving research and clinical customers.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers, including research laboratories, contract research organizations, biopharmaceutical companies and academic institutions, pay the Company for research-use-only products such as peptide pools, ELISpot plates and related immune reagents.
revenueModel.evidence: ImmuneSelect includes peptide pools, ELISpot plates and related immune reagents designed for use by research laboratories, contract research organizations, biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions and other research customers.

changes.text: In fiscal 2026, the Company discontinued its historical ViraxClear and ViraxVet third-party test kit distribution activities, which had generated revenue in fiscal 2025 and 2024.
changes.evidence: The Company previously generated revenue from historical ViraxClear and ViraxVet third-party test kit distribution activities, which are no longer active strategic product lines of the Company.
